verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs landing page claims it can "serve realistic mock responses while you build," which points to some mock-serving capability. That is the only on-topic evidence, and it does not say how mocks are created or served. Missing for 10: evidence that mocks can be generated from saved examples or an OpenAI/OpenAPI-style spec, evidence of a standalone mock server consumers can hit, setup/usage documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
